summary: Milestone 2026.05.122 operational retrospective complete. Analyzed 173 min / 40 experiments for execution efficiency. Average per experiment was 4 minutes. Slowest experiments were dominated by Exp 1591 (48 min) and recurring gate churn from Full-Scale Pipeline v3 (14 min) and arXiv Bundle v10 (10 min). GPU utilization was highly inefficient: both RTX 3090s were completely idle at 0% utilization with 4MB allocated each, failing to utilize DualGPURunner for parallel execution.
slowest_experiments: Exp 1591: Upgrade DCCD smoke to reusable structured verdict ad (48m)
Full-Scale Pipeline v3 — Gated on Exp 1414 Repair Executor (14m)
arXiv Bundle v10 - Gated on Exp 1269 Critical Fixes (10m)
bottlenecks_identified: Recurring gate churn on Full-Scale Pipeline v3 and arXiv Bundle v10
Both GPUs completely idle at 0% utilization throughout, sequential execution used instead of parallel
improvements_suggested: Use DualGPURunner to run models on GPU 0 and GPU 1 simultaneously
Implement activation-time gate/doomed-rerun preflight to emit terminal blocked artifacts instantly
Terminalize legacy gate checks (Exp 1414, Exp 1269) to stop recurring churn
top_3_highest_leverage_actions: Deploy DualGPURunner by default for all GPU-eligible tasks
Cache gate verdicts for legacy experiments (Exp 1414, Exp 1269)
Apply terminal artifact finalization to prevent repeated doomed reruns
meta_reflection: The retro continues to highlight the same recurring legacy gates and GPU idleness. Mechanical enforcement in the conductor is required.
